decisions.reason: Because this laser workstation builds directly on the firm's established marking know-how and the firm has strong in-house R&D and service capabilities, management is likely to see enough learning and improvement potential to retain it.
As a high-resolution thermal inkjet printer that is close to the core offer, it fits the firm's existing knowledge base and customer applications well, making withdrawal unlikely.

Although piezo inkjet can be somewhat more specialized, it still lies close to the firm's core coding and marking competences, so a large German firm with its own R&D is likely to keep developing rather than drop it.
